`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I haven't run it or any tests.

The 404 uses `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)`, so the body is `application/problem+json`, as the project convention requires. Before this change, a missing id made the handler call `.__dict__` on `None`, which would have raised an `AttributeError` and returned a 500.

Nothing durable came up that isn't already in EngramDB, so I didn't save any new memories.
